@graph.name: Grupo 6 IA - Knowledge Graph of Astrophysics of Galaxies publications
@graph.description: Research Object describing a reproducible pipeline for analysing 30 scientific papers about Astrophysics of Galaxies. The workflow extracts metadata and acknowledgements with GROBID, computes semantic similarity and topic modeling from abstracts, extracts NER/funding entities from acknowledgements using HuggingFace models and rules, and builds an RDF Knowledge Graph.

@graph.name: Publication analysis and KG construction workflow
@graph.description: Pipeline that downloads papers, processes PDFs with GROBID, extracts a master CSV, computes semantic similarity, performs topic modeling, extracts NER/funding entities, builds the RDF Knowledge Graph and validates the final KG.

@graph.description: Download paper PDFs from the metadata CSV.

@graph.name: Run GROBID
@graph.description: Extract TEI XML files from downloaded PDFs.
@graph.workExample: docker compose up -d grobid && python src/run_grobid.py --limit 0

@graph.name: Generate master CSV
@graph.description: Create papers_master.csv with extracted metadata, abstracts and acknowledgements.

@graph.name: Generate semantic similarity
@graph.description: Compute abstract similarity using HuggingFace sentence embeddings.

@graph.name: Generate topics
@graph.description: Generate topic assignments using BERTopic and sentence embeddings.

@graph.name: Extract NER/funding entities
@graph.description: Extract persons, organizations, funders, grants and project identifiers from acknowledgements using the selected HuggingFace NER model and regex rules.

@graph.name: Build RDF Knowledge Graph
@graph.description: Integrate papers, authors, topics, similarity and funding entities into RDF.

@graph.name: Validate KG
@graph.description: Validate that the final Turtle file parses correctly and contains expected entities.
